title: Fabulous!!
text: Fabulous!!!  Both Captain and crew mate were awesome - engaging, knowledgeable and fun!!  We love sunset cruises and regularly do one but this sail was one of the best!!  We were under sail for the majority or the trip!  Was a very special trip!
author: Susan_O

title: Wonderful Barcelona cruise
text: The trip was awesome.  Our captain and mate were terrific and the cruise was wonderful.  The cava was cold and snacks were great.
author: John_L

title: Definitely go
text: This was lovely in all ways ! Great experience, great crew, beautiful water. Totally worth it!
author: G9012KDsandrap

title: don’t skip
text: This was so awesome, highly recommend. Faith and Tomas were great! Very funny, informative, and attentive.
author: Kristen_D

title: Bob & Sharon review.
text: Really a fun and relaxing experience. Boat was very very clean. Crew was nice, helpful. Barcelona harbor is really large, we had no idea. Crew pointed out many interesting things. Snacks and drinks were good.
author: robert_l

title: Not at all disappointed
text: The boat trip completely matched what was advertised to us. Sebastian and Julian were very warm and so were the other participants. Thanks to this, we were treated to a friendly boat trip with a small Spanish snack and unlimited drinks with a magnificent view of the city from the sea. We were really not disappointed. A big thank you for organizing this activity!
author: marinawI5566AW

title: A Beautiful Evening
text: What a beautiful way to end our stay in Barcelona! It was a georgeous night, and our skipper and first mate were attentive and hospitable. We had a fantastic time, and I defninitely recommend this tour to anyone who enjoys watching a gorgeous sunset while sipping cocktails on a boat. What's not to love?!?
author: Jenny_B

title: Sunset Mediterranean Sea Cruise
text:
This Sea Barcelona cruise was perfect. With just 8 people on board, it felt like an intimate gathering rather than a big tour — we had guests from all over the world, which made for great conversation. The length of the trip was just right, and the timing was ideal: we got to watch the sunset over the beautiful Mediterranean Sea.

We got lucky with perfect weather on September 13th, and shorts with a light linen long-sleeve shirts were all we needed to stay comfortable the whole time. The ticket price included light hors d'oeuvres, beer, wine, water, and soft drinks, which was a nice touch thr
author: Randall_K

title: Sunset cruise
text: Fabulous, the captain was fantastic as well as the skipper, very good service, very pleasant and relaxing. I highly recommend

title: Sunset cruise
text:
